item.subject: science
item.stem:
Diya compares how a cow and a bird break down food. A cow may bring partially digested grass back to its mouth and chew cud again. A bird has no teeth; its gizzard has muscular walls that contract and relax, often with grit. Human chewing is different from these adaptations.

Which statement is correct?

options.A: A cow chewing freshly bitten grass for the first time is chewing cud.
options.B: Cud chewing in the cow and grinding in the bird's gizzard are adaptations that are not the same process as human chewing.
options.C: The bird also brings swallowed grass back to its mouth and chews cud.
options.D: A bird's gizzard contains teeth that chew its food.
